BrochureContent.Content:
A Rated 2 Bedroom Apartments with Exclusive Residents' Amenities

Register Your Interest at: 
https://cedarmount.ie/#register-interest

These stylish 2 bedroom apartments at Cedarmount offer a contemporary living experience within a unique, parkland setting in South Dublin.

Each apartment is thoughtfully designed to maximise light, space and comfort, with high-spec finishes throughout. Kitchens incorporate bespoke joinery and considered detailing, while bathrooms feature clean, modern layouts with integrated storage, feature lighting and elegant tiling. 

A key differentiator at Cedarmount is the inclusion of Cedarmount House — providing residents with a private suite of amenities including meeting and leisure spaces and an exercise studio, creating a lifestyle offering that goes beyond the home itself. 

Generous communal gardens and a roof-top terrace enjoying stunning views of the coastline elevate this exceptional collection of carefully considered homes. 

With Deer Park, UCD and key South Dublin amenities nearby, these apartments offer both convenience and a sense of retreat.

Key Features:
- A-rated apartments
- Modern, high-quality interiors
- Access to residents' lounge, gym and shared spaces
- Landscaped communal environment
- Prime South Dublin location
